name: Charlotte
source:
"I met a lot of people on this journey. Wonderful and fun things are coming to me!"

An energetic and slightly tomboyish girl that was raised in a country village.
One day her body suddenly became small, just about as big as a thumb, and she began to be called 'Thumbelina'.
Then her village was attacked and in order to evade her pursuers she started out on a journey with the Little Match Boy.
